summary: Iteration-7 verified BOTH fixes: (1) IST attendance timezone fix and (2) previously-flagged EmployeeOut schema (14 missing fields). BACKEND: 50/50 pytest passing overall — 25 face tests + 9 test_update_employee + 5 test_create_employee_photo + 4 NEW test_employee_out_schema (POST/GET-by-id/list/PATCH all return the full 26-key EmployeeOut) + 7 NEW test_timezone_attendance (TZ-independence, manual mark IST, match-face IST, /today IST filter, AttendanceRecord.day default = IST date) + 1 skip. Timezone helpers verified: `ist_time_str()` returns the Kolkata wall-clock even when process TZ=America/Los_Angeles; `now_ist()` is tz-aware UTC+5:30; `AttendanceRecord.day` default is `now_ist().date()`; `POST /api/attendance/mark` and `POST /api/attendance/match` both persist IST wall-clock strings ('HH:MM AM/PM'); `GET /api/attendance/today` filters by IST day (verified by seeding a same-day IST row → appears, and a yesterday-IST row → does NOT appear). EmployeeOut fix verified: POST/GET/{id}/GET list/PATCH all round-trip all 22 writable columns (gender, marital_status, dob, father_name, nominee, alt_mobile, date_of_joining, date_of_exit, current_address, permanent_address, aadhaar, pan, uan, esi, plus the prior 8) — no more blank fields on the Edit form's load. FRONTEND: static-verified — `src/utils/time.ts` exports `nowIstTime/todayIstLabel/todayIstIso`; `nowIstTime(new Date('2026-09-05T00:00:00Z'))` returns exactly '05:30 AM' and `todayIstIso(new Date('2026-09-04T20:00:00Z'))` returns exactly '2026-09-05' (verified via node); `attendance.tsx` match modal fallback uses `nowIstTime()`; `dashboard.tsx` `getGreeting()` uses `timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata'`; `attendance-records.tsx` header subtitle uses `todayIstLabel()`; grep confirms zero bare `toLocaleTimeString([]` calls anywhere in `/app/frontend/app` or `/app/frontend/src`. Timezone bug is fully resolved.

rca_of_issue: USER-REPORTED BUG: attendance was being persisted with `datetime.now().strftime('%I:%M %p')` which reflected server-local time (could be UTC in prod containers or Los_Angeles on the QA box). FIX APPLIED BY MAIN AGENT: added `IST=ZoneInfo('Asia/Kolkata')` + helpers `now_ist()`, `ist_time_str()`, `ist_date_str()`; every write site (`mark_attendance`, `match_face`) and the DB-column default (`AttendanceRecord.day`) now uses these helpers; the `/attendance/today` filter uses `now_ist().date()` so day rolls over at IST midnight. Frontend `src/utils/time.ts` mirrors this so any client-side fallback in the match-modal (`nowIstTime()` in `attendance.tsx`) also uses IST via `toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata'})`. VERIFIED: all 7 timezone regression tests pass; explicit os.environ['TZ']='America/Los_Angeles' + time.tzset() prior to calling `ist_time_str()` still returns the Kolkata wall-clock (proves TZ independence); manual mark + face-match writes fall within an IST wallclock window; /today returns the IST-today row and excludes the IST-yesterday row. SECONDARY FIX (from iter-6 HIGH bug): EmployeeOut now surfaces all 22 columns via server.py:465-491 + employee_to_out(); 4 new schema tests confirm POST/GET-by-id/GET-list/PATCH all round-trip every field. Edit Employee load now populates gender/marital_status/dob/father_name/nominee/alt_mobile/date_of_joining/date_of_exit/current_address/permanent_address/aadhaar/pan/uan/esi correctly.
